question.text: Online Dispute Resolution (ODR) / SMART ODR platform is administered by:

answer.text: SEBI — as an alternative to civil court

explanation.text: The Logic: SEBI-mandated ODR platform (SMART ODR, launched 2023) provides online mediation and arbitration for SEBI-regulated intermediary-client disputes. The Trap: BSE/NSE handle exchange disputes; ODR is SEBI-wide. Cross-Exam Context: XXI-A, XXI-B both cover; evolution since 2023. Manager's Pro-Tip: Inform clients of ODR availability in the MITC and DD — it's cheaper and faster than civil court.
